purpose: Monthly cross-sectional momentum with a volatility filter on liquid US stocks (idea proposed independently by two external reviewers). Last planned search for an edge under the current constraints: long only, free daily data.
data: Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=all (splits and dividends), active and inactive common stocks (research/round2/data/pool.json) plus SPY. The locked period is NOT downloaded unless development passes (gated in code).

universe.history: at least 253 daily bars up to the signal day, and a bar on the signal day
universe.liquidity: mean close x volume over the previous 63 sessions >= 20,000,000 USD
universe.priceFilter: none (a price floor on split-adjusted history would look ahead at later splits)
universe.funds: names classified fundLike by server/src/alpaca-trader/fundFilter.js are excluded

signal.when: close of the last session of each month
signal.volatilityFilter: drop the 20% with the highest standard deviation of daily returns over 126 sessions

execution.entry: open of the first session of the next month
execution.exit: open of the first session of the month after
execution.delisting: a stock whose bars end during the holding month exits at its last close
execution.side: long only, no leverage, no stops

costs.appliedTo: the fraction of names replaced each month (sell old plus buy new)

benchmarks.spy: SPY open-to-open over the same months
benchmarks.universe: equal weight of all stocks that pass the universe and volatility filters (the expected result of a random pick), no costs

passRuleDevelopment: ALL of: mean monthly net excess over SPY > 0 with one-sided circular block bootstrap p < 0.10 (blocks of 6 months, 5000 resamples); mean monthly net excess over the universe > 0; annualised Sharpe above SPY's; maximum drawdown no worse than 1.25 times SPY's; beats SPY in at least 3 of the calendar years
passRuleLocked: mean monthly net excess over SPY > 0, excess over the universe > 0, and Sharpe above SPY's
power: About 59 development months. With a monthly tracking error near 5% only an excess of roughly 0.8% per month or more can reach p < 0.10. A fail is therefore 'not shown', not 'proven absent'.
descriptiveOnly: delisting haircut of -30% on exits caused by the bars ending
stopRule: If development fails, the recommendation is to stop searching for an edge under the current constraints. No parameter is changed after results.
knownBiases: Alpaca's coverage of delisted symbols is partial, which flatters long-only results; the share of inactive symbols with data is reported.
